product.title: Sydney Gourmet Gold Penfolds Dinner Cruise

description.text: In Sydney, this Gourmet Gold Penfolds dinner cruise runs on Sydney Harbour from Circular Quay with a plated dinner listed on the public page. The published format is an evening harbour dining outing rather than a morning-tea discovery cruise or a one-hour sightseeing loop. The format suits visitors who want a dinner-on-the-harbour window without a helicopter booking. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Sydney, and the itinerary stays on Sydney Harbour and Circular Quay that define this outing rather than a Blue Mountains sunset walk.
